readout_other: TMS-evoked MEP amplitude in FDI, ADM and biceps brachii; MEP latency
direction_notes: MEP amplitudes were suppressed by active relative to sham SCUS at 10 W/cm2 and 1000 Hz PRF regardless of duty cycle; no significant effect at 2.5 W/cm2 or 500 Hz PRF; no modulation of biceps brachii MEPs.
safety_notes: Safety was assessed by acoustic and thermal simulation on three CT datasets (peak temperature rise about 1.3 C, MI below 1.9); no participant-level adverse event reporting.

exposures.label: SCUS to C8 spinal cord, 500 kHz, 2.5 and 10 W/cm2 ISPPA

device.model: DPX-500-4CH four-element annular array, driven by a four-channel TPO

timing.protocol_description: A 500 ms SCUS pulse train was applied to the C8 spinal segment, with a single TMS pulse delivered 100 ms before the end of the train; 15 active and 15 sham trials per session in randomised order, 10 s interstimulus interval. Four DC/PRF combinations (10 %/500 Hz, 30 %/500 Hz, 10 %/1000 Hz, 30 %/1000 Hz), one per session.

source_quotes.n_subjects: Methods: Two experiments were conducted involving 62 healthy adult participants.
source_quotes.n_sessions_per_subject: Each participant within these intensity groups completed four experimental sessions, each testing a unique parameter combination (10 % DC/500 Hz PRF; 30 % DC/500 Hz PRF; 10 % DC/1000 Hz PRF; 30 % DC/1000 Hz PRF).

Simulated mean pressure at C8 in three CT datasets for 2.5 and 10 W/cm2 conditions (0.13 and 0.25 MPa), recorded as a two-element list of the two conditions rather than a range; ISPPA likewise 0.53 and 2.12 W/cm2.
Pulse durations 0.1-0.6 ms listed as four values tied to DC/PRF combinations; stated in the text and table, not computed.
62 participants over two experiments; Experiment 2 is given as N=26 in the abstract but as 16 per arm (N=10 for biceps) in Methods.
Four sessions per participant in Experiment 1 only; Experiment 2 session count not stated.
